name: Alchemist
summary: An expert at combining reagents to produce mystical effects: healing draughts, acid and poison.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.summary: You gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies. If you already have it, you gain proficiency with another artisan's tool of your choice.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.short: Healing and acid spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class. They don't count against the number of artificer spells you prepare.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.short: After a long rest, brew a random magic elixir.
features.summary: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can produce an elixir in an empty flask. Roll for its effect: healing, swiftness, resilience (+1 AC), boldness, flight or transformation. You can make more by spending spell slots. An elixir lasts until drunk or until your next long rest.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.short: Add INT to healing, acid, fire, necrotic and poison spell rolls.
features.summary: When you cast a spell using alchemist's supplies as the focus, add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to one roll of the spell that restores hit points or deals acid, fire, necrotic or poison damage.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.short: Elixirs grant temp HP; cast Lesser Restoration for free.
features.summary: A creature that drinks your experimental elixir gains temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence modifier. You can cast Lesser Restoration without a slot a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier per long rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.short: Resist acid and poison; free Greater Restoration and Heal.
features.summary: You gain resistance to acid and poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition. Once per long rest each, you can cast Greater Restoration and Heal without a slot or material components.
